request: Draw a blue circle inside a red cube

parts.name: floor_shadow
parts.desc: Soft elliptical shadow under the cube, centered at (405,515) with radii 230x40, filled with a radial gradient from #5A4A42 at 45% alpha in the center to fully transparent at the edge.

parts.name: cube_back_faces
parts.desc: Inside walls of a red cube in oblique view: back face square (300,140)-(600,440), left wall polygon (200,220)-(300,140)-(300,440)-(200,520), floor polygon (200,520)-(300,440)-(600,440)-(500,520). Fill back face #8E1B1B, left wall a linear gradient #C62828 to #8E1B1B, floor #A32222, all opaque.

parts.name: blue_sphere
parts.desc: Blue ball floating inside the cube, centered at (400,330) with radius 100. Fill with a radial gradient offset toward the top-left (focus at 365,295): #8FC1FF at 0, #1E5BB8 at 0.55, #0D2F66 at 1. Add a small soft white #FFF8F0 highlight ellipse near (365,290).

parts.name: cube_front_faces
parts.desc: Translucent front glass of the red cube drawn over the sphere: front face square (200,220)-(500,520), top face polygon (200,220)-(300,140)-(600,140)-(500,220), right face polygon (500,220)-(600,140)-(600,440)-(500,520). Fill the front with #C62828 at 28% alpha, the top with #F28B82 at 35% alpha, and the right with #8E1B1B at 35% alpha, so the blue sphere stays clearly visible.

parts.name: cube_edges
parts.desc: Stroke all 12 cube edges at 4px with round joins: outer silhouette and front edges in #8E1B1B, the three hidden back edges meeting at (300,440) as a dashed #8E1B1B line at 50% alpha. Add a thin #F28B82 highlight line along the top-left edges (200,220)-(300,140)-(600,140).
